summary: Frontend-only Better-T-Stack scaffold matches the contract: bts.jsonc disables backend, database, auth, API, payments, and deploy; Vite/Vitest uses jsdom with a setup file; the Chinese product identity 育爱成长 renders as a visible h1 and is asserted via getByRole + toBeVisible. Evidence shows TDD RED/GREEN, typecheck, production build, scoped Biome, and a clean secret scan. No secrets, PII, auth surfaces, destructive operations, network calls, or supply-chain risks appear in the bundle. Only low-severity observations: the doubled apps/web/apps/web nesting and Tailwind not being directly visible in the sanitized diff. No P0.
